jobs.description: WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FORIn the role of the ILS Specialist - Technical Publication for BOXER you are responsible for all matters regarding the Interactive Electronic Technical Publication (IETP) of the leading multi-national 8x8 military armoured vehicle programme. At the industry consortium ARTEC, all technical and cross-discipline activities are focused on making a good product even better to protect the future and security of Europe and Worldwide.Parts of the ILS Specialist role:- Administrator of the ILS tooling landscape for Interactive Electronic Technical Publication (IETP) of the BOXER programme (i.e. QuILS)- Fulfilling the publication and delivery process of IETP / AESP- Coordination of another ILS discipline (e.g. Logistics Support Analysis (LSA), Materiel Management, etc.)- Coordination of our main subcontractors- Host and chair review meetings with our customer Nations- Coordinate activities throughout ARTEC's internal disciplines- Be responsible for time, cost and quality for IETP activities in BOXER programme- Continuous improvement of processes and monitoring of KPIs- Support the logistic configuration process- Bachelor degree, engineer, technician or comparable qualification- Experience in customer support and/or defence area, preferable armoured vehicle manufacturer desired- Experience in one of the logistics main disciplines (technical publication, materiel management or logistics support analysis)- At least knowledge in S1000D required- Experience in administration of a Common Source Database (CSDB) acc. to S1000D- Conceptual understanding of materiel management process (S2000M) advantageous- Strong organizational and communication skills- Ability to quickly understand and facilitate complex technical relations- Business fluent in German and English written and spoken- Strong scheduling / planning skills- Understanding of database logic (preferably MS Access or ORACLE)- MIL-STD-1388 knowledge advantageousARTEC is characterized by a flat hierarchy with a project-matrix organisation. This provides the opportunity for you as BOXER ILS-Specialist to work on multiple international projects with different team members from different countries at the same time.The office is located in Munich - the most liveable city in Germany.- Interesting and varied opportunities in a leading role for large scale and demanding International and National projects across the whole life cycle (development, series production, In-Service Support) of a state-of-the art military vehicle- Development opportunities for both personal and professional growth within the organization- Individual training opportunities offered by externals as well as a consortium owned academy- A state-of-the-art office that is easily accessible by public or private transport within Munich- Attractive payment package and pension- 30 leave days and a variety of flexible working models that allow time off for yourself and your family- Flexible working hours incl. 40% mobile working possible as a standard- Wide range of corporate benefits- Offsite and team building events to underline the modern working environment- Canteen and medical service at the location- Job Bike- Subsidized D-Ticket

Our corporate culture fosters personal development, open dialogue, and authentic connections. As a pioneer in healthcare, we know: Every minute counts. When a diagnostic system in a laboratory stands still, patients are waiting for vital results. You ensure that our systems run smoothly, thus contributing directly to securing the healthcare of tomorrow. Become part of Roche, where every voice matters.Your new team:You will be part of our EMEA Customer Support Center Hub here in Mannheim. We are a team of technical and application experts supporting customers in the RCSC countries (Germany, Austria, Switzerland, the Netherlands, Belgium, Greece, and Turkey). Cohesion and working in intercultural teams are important to us; we work closely networked, including with 2nd-level support and our colleagues in the field.Responsibilities | What awaits youAs a Technical Specialist (m/f/d), you are the technical interface to our customers and colleagues. Your goal is to find fast and sustainable solutions for complex inquiries. Your main tasks include:* As the central point of contact, you process customer and employee inquiries by phone and email.* You use remote services for customer support and, if necessary, simulate customer situations in our laboratory to quickly identify and resolve errors.* You document your solution approaches structured in our CRM system and handle advanced complaint management for medium-complexity issues.* You work closely with 2nd-level support and escalate product quality problems to the next competence level. Occasionally, you also support the technical field service during on-site activities.* We are flexible regarding your work location. Your place of work can be Mannheim (Germany), Almere (Netherlands) or Diegem (Belgium). In any case, you actively seek exchange and collaboration with your colleagues at the RCSC in Mannheim.Qualifications | What you bringIn addition to successfully completed training as a Medical Technical Assistant (MTA), Technician (e.g., Mechatronics, Medical Technology, Electrical Engineering), or a Bachelor's degree (e.g., Natural Sciences, IT, Chemical or Electrical Engineering), you have initial professional experience in the medical technology field, either through technical customer support (field service or hotline) or in a laboratory function. Furthermore, the following points round out your profile:* You speak fluent Dutch/Flemish (C1). You also communicate confidently in English (min. B1/B2). Fluent German speaking skills are desirable.* You have good user knowledge of medical analysis systems or, alternatively, know-how in robotics, mechanics, or electrical engineering. Basic IT network knowledge and familiarity with CRM tools are familiar to you.* You are strongly customer-oriented, a real team player in intercultural teams, and possess pronounced methodical competence in troubleshooting.Your Application We ask you for the following documents:* Current CVFurther documents are not mandatory at this time. Please note before submitting your application that no further documents can be added afterward.Apply now – we look forward to it!Your contact to us! With people. For people.Do you need further support?Please have a look at our FAQs, you will find them via https://careers.roche.com/global/en/faq.Who we areA healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.Let’s build a healthier future, together.Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description: About usAirbus ist Pionier einer nachhaltigen Luft- und Raumfahrt für eine sichere und vereinte Welt. Das Unternehmen arbeitet ständig an Innovationen für effiziente und technologisch fortschrittliche Lösungen in den Bereichen Luft- und Raumfahrt, Verteidigung sowie vernetzte Dienstleistungen. Im Bereich Hubschrauber stellt Airbus die weltweit effizientesten Lösungen und Dienstleistungen für zivile und militärische Hubschrauber bereit.Job descriptionIn order to support the Supportability Engineering team, Airbus Defence and Space is looking for aMaster student in the field of Supportability Engineering (d/f/m), title of thesis “Machine Learning based Pattern recognition”You are looking for a master thesis? Then apply now! We look forward to you supporting us in the Supportability Engineering team as a master student (d/f/m)!- Location: Manching- Start: 01.11.2025- Duration: 6 monthsYour locationLocated about an hour’s drive north of Munich, Manching is an up-and-coming market town that offers a wide range of leisure and cultural activities. Here, you can enjoy the quality of life in the countryside while the pleasures of near-by cities are still within easy reach.Your benefits- Attractive salary and work-life balance with a 35-hour week (flexitime).- Traveling within Europe is possible after consultation and agreement from the department.- International environment with the opportunity to network globally.- Work with modern/diversified technologies.- At Airbus, we see you as a valuable team member and you are not hired to brew coffee, instead you are in close contact with the interfaces and are part of our weekly team meetings.- Opportunity to participate in the Generation Airbus Community to expand your own network.Thesis TopicThe work includes the definition, implementation, and evaluation of suitable machine learning models for analysing and classifying diagnostic patterns based on historical or simulated data from real-world testability use cases.Your tasks and responsibilities- Analyse and preprocess diagnostic data from test systems- Identify characteristic failure patterns and symptom relationships- Define and compare suitable model architectures for fault detection and isolation (e.g. decision trees, ensemble models, neural networks, clustering approaches, etc.)- Train and validate models using established ML frameworks (e.g. scikit-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch) and MATLAB Simulink (e.g. Artificial Intelligence (AI))- Evaluate model performance using metrics such as detection rate, false alarm rate, and isolation accuracy- Integrate your approach into an existing analysis pipeline or tool environment- Document and present your results to stakeholdersDesired skills and qualifications- Full time enrolled student (d/f/m) in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Data Science, Mathematics, or a related field- Solid understanding of machine learning concepts and data preprocessing- Practical experience with MATLAB Simulink and ML frameworks (e.g. scikit-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch)- Programming skills (e.g. Python)- Interest in fault detection, diagnostics, and system testability- Analytical mindset, structured working style, and ability to work independently- Basic knowledge of test or diagnostic systems (e.g. FMEA/FMECA) is a plus- Language skills: English fluent; French basic knowledgePlease upload the following documents: cover letter, CV, relevant transcripts, enrollment certificate.Not a 100% match? No worries! As a team, we are unbeatable – we have impressively proven this even in times of Corona. MEAG – All Assets. One Team. We are looking to further strengthening our highly motivated Transaction Team in the Infrastructure Equity division. Dynamic capital markets meet a strong team spirit and a modern working environment in Munich Schwabing. The Infrastructure Equity portfolio reflects MEAG's expertise in all major infrastructure sectors in Europe and the USA. MEAG IE follows a long-term orientated buy & build investment strategy within four main investment themes: Energy Transition, Sustainable Transport, Digital Infrastructure and Essential Infrastructure. We acquire minorities, co-control and majorities in mid-market companies in line with our core/ core+ investment approach and strive to grow them throughout our ownership with an pro-active asset management approachWith your endurance, decision-making strength and performance orientation, you make a significant contribution to our team's success. jobs.description: Weitere Berufsbezeichnung:Working Student - Communication & Training for ProductionStellenbeschreibung:Company DescriptionContinental is a leading tire manufacturer and industry specialist. Founded in 1871, the company generated sales of €19.7 billion in 2025 and currently employs around 76,000 people in 54 countries and markets.Tire solutions from the Tires group sector make mobility safer, smarter, and more sustainable. Its premium portfolio encompasses car, truck, bus, two-wheel, and specialty tires as well as smart solutions and services for fleets and tire retailers. jobs.employer_name: KiTA An der Bucerius Law School e.V
jobs.description: Create your own happiness!Are you a passionate early childhood educator (m/f/d)? Do you put your heart and soul into your work, but haven’t been satisfied with your working conditions so far?Come check us out—maybe you’ll like what you find here?What you can look forward to…The basics: pay, vacation time, and working hours.We are actually offering a fixed-term full-time position. The full-time workweek is 38 hours. Initially, the contract would be fixed-term, but an extension is possible.Pay is based on the TVöD SuE collective bargaining agreement and depends on your professional experience and qualifications. A 13th month’s salary (at 100%, instead of 85%) is paid after one year of service. We have between 32 and 34 days of vacation per year. Christmas Eve and New Year’s Eve are paid holidays. The cost of an HVV/Deutschlandticket is fully covered, and if interested, you can participate in a fitness program.The Position: Responsibilities and Working Conditions.We are looking for at least one new early childhood educator with a perfect command of the English language.Your responsibilities include the attentive care, nurturing, and support of the children (age 1-6) entrusted to us in line with our educational approach, working closely with the children, parents, and the entire team. In your daily work, you would speak mainly English.We would appreciate at least some experience in this field and a preference for this age group would be advantageous.Our working conditions are truly worth highlighting: In the elementary section, four colleagues together care for 35 children; in the nursery section, four additional colleagues care for 16 children. In addition, we employ a housekeeping staff member with educational qualifications and, in the future, a substitute.We hold weekly team meetings to discuss weekly schedules, activities, and specific situations, as well as to plan parent-teacher conferences and developmental meetings. Our sponsoring organization places great emphasis on providing good working conditions.The Team: One for all, all for one!Some of us have been working together successfully and happily for over ten years. It goes without saying that we support one another and treat each other with care. Our sense of humor and our willingness to stand up for one another carry us through the sometimes hectic daily routine of the daycare center.On concept days, we discuss educational topics, engage in professional development, and reflect on our work. Regular weekly team meetings, preparation time, and supervision are just as much a part of our routine as extended get-togethers during company outings and Christmas parties.Has this piqued your curiosity? Then you should definitely keep reading…Important: Empathy, joy, and qualifications.To ensure we comply with legal requirements, it is very important that our new team member holds a completed, state-recognized qualification as an early childhood educator (m/f/d), a degree in early childhood education or early childhood development, or a degree as a social pedagogue (m/f/d). It would be helpful if you have a good understanding of the English language, as we are a bilingual facility.We are looking for an empathetic person with a Reggio Emilia approach (including a child-centered perspective) and someone who genuinely enjoys working with children, because we want you to look forward to coming to work.Feel free to get to know us!The Daycare Center: Location. Concept. Focus Areas.The daycare center is located in the heart of Planten un Blomen and is surrounded by plenty of greenery. It is easily accessible by public transportation from all parts of Hamburg (Gänsemarkt, Dammtor, Stephansplatz).There are two groups, a nursery group and an elementary group, in which 42-48 children are currently cared for by nine early childhood educators. Our facilities allow us to organize various projects and activities in workshops and specialized rooms.The foundation of our concept is the Reggio approach. Above all, it reflects our attitude toward others and how we wish to approach life’s changes. Our daycare is a place for self-directed, holistic learning, and we foster a respectful approach not only toward the children entrusted to us, but toward all people.We integrate key areas such as yoga, woodworking, art studio work, language development, music, relaxation and movement, and preschool preparation into our daily routine. Do you have a particular focus? A passion? Let’s find out together if we can integrate this into our daily routine as well…Start up initiative: Kindertagesstätte an der Bucerius Law School e.V.Our small operator, “Kindertagesstätte an der Bucerius Law School e.V.”, was founded in 2008 and is a member of the Paritätischer Wohlfahrtsverband Hamburg. Loki Schmidt was the founding patron of our daycare center.Our organization consists of a single facility. This means that decisions can be made and implemented quickly, easily, and on an individual basis. Here, people are still allowed to be people; they are heard and are not just a personnel number.As a member of the Bucerius family and an initiative of the ZEIT STIFTUNG BUCERIUS, our work makes an important contribution to promoting an open, democratic society.The Future: Do you think we’re a good fit for you?Then please send us your application materials. We would love to get to know you.If you’re interested, feel free to check out our website (https://www.law-school.de/services/kita (https://www.law-school.de/services/kita) ) or our Instagram account (kita.buceriuslaw).Thank you for your attention, and we hope to see you soon!

Location: Bremen, Germany; 100% office-basedSchedule: Regularly 8:00 a.m.-5:00 p.m., with a half-day FridayGlobal communication: International messages may arrive outside normal hours; routine responses are handled during working time unless otherwise agreedSalary: Salary range: €52,000–€60,000 gross annually, depending on qualifications and experience.Travel: No regular travel; occasional team events onlyReports to: Managing Director, PHENOGY Europe GmbH / International Business Development ManagerRole OverviewPHENOGY is seeking an experienced, highly organized professional to support the Managing Director and strengthen coordination across the business. This role turns executive activity into clear communication, reliable follow-through, and practical value for the wider team. The successful candidate will manage a complex international schedule, coordinate correspondence and stakeholder communication, prepare meeting notes and executive memos, and help ensure that priorities, commitments, and formal processes move forward.The position is office-based and works closely with colleagues, senior executives, government and university contacts, customers, partners, and other external stakeholders. It requires sound judgment, discretion, confidence, and the ability to understand context—not simply complete assigned tasks.Key Responsibilities- Manage the Managing Director's calendar across multiple time zones, including calls, meetings, conferences, and keynote engagements; prevent conflicts and ensure the Managing Director is fully prepared.- Track calls, emails, commitments, deadlines, and follow-ups; discuss priorities with the Managing Director, provide timely reminders, and help drive tasks through completion.- Draft and coordinate professional email correspondence and respond directly to internal and external stakeholders within agreed parameters.- Capture notes from key meetings and convert them into clear memos, decisions, action items, and updates so the Managing Director's work creates value for the broader organization.- Maintain an effective flow of information between the Managing Director and PHENOGY's teams, including keeping him informed of relevant internal and external developments.- Serve as a trusted point of contact when the Managing Director is traveling or unavailable; resolve routine matters, route requests, and escalate issues appropriately.- Coordinate communication with C-level executives, managing directors, government representatives, universities, colleagues across PHENOGY, and key internal partners.- Support formal administrative processes involving public authorities and universities, including research-project applications, certifications, tenders, and related documentation and deadlines.- Prepare and format presentations, executive briefings, meeting materials, customer and project documents, and maintain accurate records in relevant office and CRM systems.What Success Looks Like in the First 6-12 Months- The Managing Director's calendar, commitments, and communications are organized, accurate, and reliably followed through.- Important meetings and external engagements are translated into useful memos, decisions, and actions that keep the wider team informed and aligned.- The role develops trusted working relationships, increasingly exercises sound independent judgment, and earns positive feedback from the Managing Director and team.Required Qualifications- At least 3 years of experience in executive assistance, executive coordination, business development support, or a comparable role supporting senior leadership.- Native-level or fully fluent German and good professional English, with the ability to prepare polished correspondence, meeting summaries, and executive memos.- Demonstrated success managing complex calendars, competing priorities, international time zones, and high volumes of communication and follow-up.- Working knowledge of the administrative and legal frameworks used by public authorities and universities, including research-project applications, certifications, and tenders—or directly comparable experience.- Strong command of Microsoft Office, especially Outlook, Word, and PowerPoint; confidence learning and maintaining CRM and other internal systems.- Excellent judgment, discretion, diplomacy, and situational awareness when communicating with senior business, government, academic, and external stakeholders.- A proactive, structured, and service-oriented approach, with the ability to connect information, anticipate needs, and work effectively in a fast-moving international environment.Preferred Experience- Experience in battery technology, energy storage, BESS, clean energy, or another technical industry.- Experience supporting public funding, research partnerships, certification processes, or institutional stakeholders.- Experience in a startup, scale-up, or internationally distributed organization.

Contribute to advanced analog development for cutting-edge electric power testing systems trusted worldwide! This job will provide you with an opportunity to further your career alongside some of the best and most passionate technology experts from around the world in a leading company within the test, measurement and data analytics industry. You will be a strong contributor, collaborating closely with colleagues from various business functions.In this medior/senior position, you’ll play a key role in developing high‑performance circuits that power precision measurement technologies used by leading companies worldwide. Your expertise will help drive innovation and ensure our products continue to set the standard for accuracy and reliability.Primary responsibilitiesYou will, as a Analog Hardware Engineer (m/w/d) be responsible for developing and sustaining our state-of-the-art electric power testing DAQ solutions at our site in Darmstadt.Your development activities- Develop and maintain analog designs for different data acquisition systems.- Research new analog designs with the help of simulation (e.g. LTSpice).- Schematics design and layout of PCBs for analog systems.- Set and verify specifications for data acquisition products.- Define tests for production to (automatically) validate analog hardware.- Keep in contact with (major) manufacturers to monitor trends in analog product development.- Assist in the CE certification process and support during external certification, both for EMC as well as low voltage safety.Professional qualifications- Min 5 – 10 years’ experience in analog design.- Excellent understanding of analog components and design principles, for example circuits including Op-Amps, analog filters, A/D converters, etc.- A good knowledge of PCB design’s influence on noise, crosstalk etc. Optimum component placement and routing.- Grounding and EMC design- Knowledge of design-to-cost- Experience in circuit design using Altium Designer- Usage of Spice-simulation during the design phase- Good communication skills with other involved parties such as: ECAD, firmware, test department, QA, production, etc.Personal skills- Good communication skills in English, both verbally and in writing.- Good interpersonal skills- Team player, but also able to solve problems individually.- Hands on, able to or used to work from prototype to production phase.- Accurate, practical and result driven personality.- Experience in working in international located development team is a plus.We OfferFreedom with responsibility is the framework for HBK’s employees. This allows for a good balance between work and family life and for constant development of professional and personal skills in an international and enjoyable working environment.One company – HBKOn 1 January 2019, Brüel & Kjær and HBM merged their activities into a new company called HBK (Hottinger Brüel & Kjær). With more than 3,500 employees worldwide and production facilities in Denmark, Germany, the UK, the USA, China and Portugal and presence in 80 countries, HBK is a leading player in the test and measurement area. For further info please visit www.hbkworld.com.Homeoffice:Umfang: Nach Vereinbarung

jobs.occupation: Offshore HVDC Site Coordinator / Electrical Supervisor (Ingenieur/in - Elektrotechnik)
jobs.description: We are looking for an experienced Electrical Supervisor to support offshore HVDC converter platform activities, covering maintenance, troubleshooting, commissioning, and site coordination. The role combines technical oversight, contractor management, electrical safety leadership, and interface coordination within a complex offshore energy environment. Candidates with HVDC, offshore wind, or high-voltage infrastructure experience are highly preferred.Your Tasks- Coordinate and supervise maintenance, troubleshooting, repair, and commissioning activities on offshore HVDC converter platforms.- Manage OEMs, contractors, and service providers while ensuring efficient execution of offshore works.- Ensure compliance with HSE requirements, Permit-to-Work systems, LOTO procedures, and electrical safety standards.- Monitor work progress, technical quality, schedule adherence, and compliance with project requirements.- Coordinate interfaces between operations, engineering, commissioning, HSE teams, and contractors.- Track technical defects, non-conformities, and outstanding works while preparing site reports and escalating critical issues.- Assume VEFK (Responsible Electrical Person) duties where formally appointed.Your qualifications- Technician, Master Craftsman, or equivalent qualification in Electrical Engineering, Power Engineering, or a related discipline.- Experience within offshore wind, HVDC/HGÜ systems, substations, high-voltage installations, or energy infrastructure projects.- Strong knowledge of HV/MV equipment, electrical isolation procedures, LOTO, and Permit-to-Work systems.- Experience in site supervision, contractor coordination, maintenance, and/or commissioning activities.- VEFK qualification or solid experience within the German electrical safety framework is highly desirable.- Good understanding of HVDC converter systems and reactive power compensation systems is an advantage.- Strong HSE mindset, proactive approach, and ability to work independently.- Good English skills; German language skills are considered beneficial.- Willingness to work offshore, travel regularly, and participate in standby rotations.- Offshore medical fitness and offshore safety certification (or willingness to obtain them).
